disposition_records.T12-FP16-PER-LOAD-ALLOCATION: Root cause: the module-internal UnsafeRawPointer.loadUnaligned(as:) in BinaryFormat.swift shadowed the stdlib and allocated, copied and freed 16 B per call (168 sites in 54 functions). Both shadows were deleted. Release D4 per invocation: aos-fp16-reused 262,145/393,217/786,433 → 1; setup → 4,099; optimized-fp16 524,289/786,433 → 1. 16-B slowAlloc sites 168 → 0. 450 fixture sections are byte-identical. Serialization reads were never affected (they bind to the stdlib BitwiseCopyable overload; root premise corrected in phase 2).
disposition_records.T12-STDLIB-SHADOW-CLASS: Closed mechanically by Scripts/ci/tests/test_no_stdlib_member_shadows.py: a curated stdlib member list per extended type (raw pointers, SIMD) with must-fail and must-pass fixtures. Pinned allowlist: the two SIMDExtensions sum() declarations (semantic review routed to T14).
disposition_records.T12-FP16-CONVERTER-COVERAGE: FP16ConverterExhaustiveTests: sync, Float16-free, unguarded. 65,536 decodes, 63,490 round trips and 190,464 RNE inputs against independent integer references; NaN pins on every encode and decode path including the MixedPrecisionFactory entry points.
disposition_records.T12-NAN-ENCODING-POLICY: One policy: encode any NaN to sign|0x7E00, decode any NaN to 0x7FC00000. Only the arm64 NEON chunk path changed (0x7fc12345: 0x7e09 → 0x7e00); RED-first. Across all 2^32 FP32 inputs the non-NaN digest is unchanged, and non-canonical NaN outputs fell 16,744,448 → 0 (one-host probe records outside the repo). CHANGELOG Changed.
